watches.name: Makara Octopus (Refurbished)
watches.description: These watches are refurbished or demo units. They are fully functional, but they may exhibit one or more of the following cosmetic defects: - minor signs of use (very light scratches or dings) - weak bezel lume - small dust particle on dial or under sapphire bezel - mismatched caseback serial number Most of the watches only exhibit weak bezel lume. ALL OF THESE WATCHES HAVE SOME BEZEL PLAY. The watches come in a wooden box. All watches come with a brown leather strap. Full 1-year warranty still applies, but excludes the defects mentioned above.
